loop.description: Read the task seed + any linked docs; summarize constraints and unknowns.
exit_criteria: Unknowns listed in contract.open_questions OR resolved

loop.description: Locate the relevant Rust/TS code paths and existing patterns.
exit_criteria: Relevant files listed (paths) in evidence report

loop.description: Write contract.json with pre/post/invariants/errors + acceptance tests.
exit_criteria: contract has acceptance_tests IDs and descriptions

loop.description: Ask up to 3 blocking questions per round; stop and wait after questions; repeat until open_questions is empty.
exit_criteria: All blocking decisions resolved OR explicitly recorded as assumptions

loop.description: Set contract.status=ready only when open_questions is empty.
Implement minimal diff to satisfy the contract; no unrelated edits.
exit_criteria: Code changes align to contract clauses

loop.description: Run Rust + TS tests/lints/build as applicable; fix until green.
Produce evidence pack mapping contract clauses -> proving tests/assertions.
Update contract.status=implemented only when DoD satisfied.
